children.value: > Fact From Story: Alameda could withdraw money even when its accounts didn’t have any, and it had an enormous line of credit.
> > Fact From Story: Wang added that it could place orders faster than other users, and we already saw evidence that users may have unwittingly deposited money into Alameda rather than FTX.
> > > Fact From Story: Alameda also allegedly kept FTX from looking bad by assuming some of its losses.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies sometimes make arrangements to help each other out.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A line of credit is an agreement from a bank or financial institution to lend a business a specific amount of money.
> Fact From Story: Wang was the co-founder and chief technology officer of FTX, as well as the co-founder of Alameda Research.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A company's CTO would have the ability to grant special privileges to another related company.
